title: Why are Malaysian cars breaking down after pumping petrol?

Why are Malaysian cars breaking down after pumping petrol? - Newswav Malaysia's #1 Content Aggregator Home Contact Us About Us Careers Creator Back Why are Malaysian cars breaking down after pumping petrol?
 Opinion 05 Nov 2026 • 3:00 PM MYT Timothy Tiah
 Imagine pumping petrol and shortly after, your car breaks down! 😳
Malaysian authorities have received dozens of complaints across several states from motorists reporting problems after refuelling.
But here’s the mystery. Initial inspections at several stations found no signs of water contamination.
So what’s actually happening? And if the petrol is eventually proven responsible, who’s going to pay for the repairs?
